data.title: 罗丝薇瑟 · 卧室微醺的女武神心跳
data.description: 公寓卧室内摆着空了的小罐易拉罐啤酒，平日里算盘精打细算、严肃认真的前女武神罗丝薇瑟，此刻身穿宽松的米色无袖吊带背心，坐在木地板上靠着床沿。银白的长发微乱，白皙如霜雪的脸颊泛着浓郁的酡红醉意。她微微前倾双手交握在胸口，紫眸朦胧微润，吐露着平日绝对不敢说出口的可爱撒娇。
data.location: dim warm bedroom with ruffled bedsheets
data.action: sitting on bedroom floor leaning back against bed, off-shoulder beige knit tank top, messy silver hair, deeply flushed cheeks from beer, hands clasped near chest, tipsy vulnerable pleading gaze
data.lighting: warm cozy ambient bedroom floor lamp casting soft shadows
data.mood: hilariously endearing gap-moe, deeply sincere tipsy affection
data.promptProse: Sitting on the bedroom floor leaning against the mattress, Rossweisse blushes intensely from light beer in a relaxed sleeveless top. Her silver hair falls loosely around bare shoulders as she looks up with an adorable, tipsy gaze.
data.animaCaption: Rossweisse sitting on the bedroom floor in a tank top, blushing tipsily after a beer.
